name: Governance Rules
definition: Rules governing an undertaking such as a guarantee or standby letter of credit.

ApplicableLaw.name: Applicable Law
ApplicableLaw.definition: Law under which the undertaking has been issued.

PublicationAgency.name: Publication Agency
PublicationAgency.definition: Agency that publishes the governance rules.

ModelForm.name: Model Form
ModelForm.definition: Model form to which the governance rules apply.

Jurisdiction.name: Jurisdiction
Jurisdiction.definition: Jurisdiction which applies to the governance rules.
